title: Screen reader semantics — ARIA landmarks and roles
objective: Verify that governed surfaces use correct ARIA landmarks, roles, and semantic HTML to support screen reader navigation. Based on WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.

source.description: Surface-level HTML must provide semantic structure for assistive technology — add-on surfaces inherit this requirement

execution.criteria: Inspect HTML structure: banner landmark, navigation landmark, main content region, complementary region, status region. Verify each interactive element has an accessible name.
execution.expected_outcome: All ARIA landmarks present, interactive elements have accessible names

pass_criteria.description: Page has banner, navigation, main, and contentinfo landmarks
evidence_required: HTML includes role=banner, role=navigation, role=main, role=contentinfo

pass_criteria.description: Status indicators have accessible names (not just color)
evidence_required: State badges include aria-label or visible text

pass_criteria.description: Interactive cards and panels are focusable with correct roles
evidence_required: Bento cards have role=button or role=region
